name: Mornington Farmers' Market
signature: A second-Saturday farmers market in Mornington Park, separate from the Wednesday Main Street Market.
editorNote: The Mornington Chamber lists Mornington Farmers Market in Mornington Park on the second Saturday of each month, 8am–1pm. This is separate from the weekly Wednesday Main Street Market. Check the Chamber's current calendar before travelling.
whyWeGo: A monthly produce market in Mornington Park, distinct from the Wednesday street market.
ifOnlyOneThing: Check the Chamber's current market calendar, then head to Mornington Park.
